card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits or spaces inside parenthesized section cross-references like (2.2) or (12.3) in highlights text. Also fires on a few other mid-term spots such as inside CYP3A4, RUCONEST, and 'and' in a risk heading.

modes.label: Section number references
modes.description: The first digit or the space right after the opening parenthesis of a section reference.

modes.label: Inside names and headings
modes.description: Partway through a drug or enzyme name, or an 'and' joining two risks in a heading.
